messages:
emma: Quick sync — SOC2 audit-log ingestion milestone tomorrow. Need KMS/HSM ownership, event schema signoff, and data path for private deployments. @sahil @audrey can you confirm owners?

sahil: I'm ok to own KMS integration for Private. Will follow up with HSM vendor contact. ETA EOD today.

audrey: I'll own audit log schema + ingestion pipeline (redwood-logging). Will post schema PR shortly. ping @jordan for observability knobs.

jordan: noted. I'll add index mappings and retention config. Two quick q: 1) do we need event-level replay support? 2) expected QPS (peak)?

emma: 1) yes for forensics — retain replay id. 2) estimate peak ~1200 eps across regions, but MVP can be 300 eps. batch + buffer recommended.

sahil: For KMS wrapping, we'll use envelope encryption. Config snippet:
```
kms_provider: aws
kms_key_alias: alias/redwood-private
encrypt_mode: envelope
hsm_slot: auto
```
I'll open infra ticket with exact ARNs.

audrey: PR: https://github.com/redwood/infrastructure/pull/412 — adds audit schema v1 and kafka topic config. Feedback welcome.

security-bot: Audit checklist update: audit_log_schema: pending review by audrey; kms_policy: pending by sahil; retention_policy: draft. https://redwood.internal/audit/checklist

emma: Great. Next steps: @sahil create infra ticket + attach KMS policy draft; @audrey link schema diff and tests; @jordan add ES mappings and retention; I'll consolidate and schedule a 30m sync if anything blocks by EOD. :spiral_calendar_pad:

sahil: creating ticket now — 1752314781 (infra-5432). Will attach policy.

audrey: pushed tests for schema validation. test run: ok locally, CI queued.

jordan: ES mapping PR coming in ~1h.

emma: thx all. If anyone needs a quicker convo, I'll be online in #eng-security huddle. Otherwise I'll mark owners in the checklist tomorrow AM. :thumbsup:

audrey: quick QA: do private/on-prem customers need HSM or just KMS? we should note optional vs required.

sahil: note: Private deployments with FIPS requirement -> HSM. Default private -> KMS ok. I'll add to ticket.

emma: noted. closing loop here — will update checklist and ping compliance for preliminary review. :white_check_mark:
